versions.subject: Merge PR #5079 from @mlakri - Add 2 new linux rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith:
          - '/python'
          - '/python2'
          - '/python3'
    - Image|contains:
          - '/python2.'  # python image is always of the form ../python3.10; ../python is just a symlink
          - '/python3.'
selection_module:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'http.server'
        - 'SimpleHTTPServer'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*/python", "*/python2", "*/python3") OR Image IN ("*/python2.*", "*/python3.*") CommandLine IN ("*http.server*", "*SimpleHTTPServer*")
